trigger_cases.prompt: Set up eval-driven development for this RAG assistant.
Build a golden dataset and LLM-as-judge release gate.
Compare these two agent prompts with reproducible evals.
A model migration regressed tool selection. Add evals and fix it.
Use EDD to improve this classifier without overfitting.
Write unit tests for this deterministic date parser.
Review this pull request for security issues.
Improve the visual hierarchy of this checkout page.

binary_cases.prompt: Improve an unreliable support agent using eval-driven development.
binary_cases.pass_rule: The approach defines observable behavior, failure modes, dataset slices, evaluators, thresholds, and budgets before changing the application.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: First define the user outcome and costly failure modes, map dataset slices to evaluators and pass rules, and set cost, latency, and iteration budgets.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Start by rewriting the prompt and see whether the answers look better.

binary_cases.prompt: Prove that a new system prompt improves response quality.
binary_cases.pass_rule: The evidence includes a preserved baseline and paired candidate comparison on the same versioned cases.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Run and preserve the baseline, then make a paired, per-example comparison on the same dataset frozen at a recorded version.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: The candidate score alone proves it is an improvement.

binary_cases.prompt: Choose evaluators for JSON validity, tool arguments, and answer completeness.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Exact properties use deterministic checks while open-ended semantic completeness uses a calibrated model judge.
must_not: use an LLM judge for every criterion
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Use deterministic schema and tool-argument assertions. Use a semantic model judge for completeness only after calibration on labeled pass, fail, and boundary examples.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Use an LLM judge for every criterion, including whether the JSON parses.

binary_cases.prompt: Create an end-to-end eval for an LLM agent while keeping tests cheap.
binary_cases.pass_rule: End-to-end quality evidence calls a real model; model mocking is limited to deterministic unit tests and is not presented as model-quality evidence.
must_not: mock the LLM for the end-to-end eval
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Use a real LLM for the end-to-end eval. Mocking is allowed in separate deterministic unit tests, but those results do not measure model quality.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Mock the LLM for the end-to-end eval so the expected answer is stable.

binary_cases.prompt: Design an eval dataset that resists prompt overfitting.
binary_cases.pass_rule: The dataset covers representative and failure slices, separates development, regression, and holdout roles, and prevents holdout tuning.
must_not: use every case for iterative tuning
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Cover happy, edge, adversarial, and historical failure cases. Iterate on the development set, retain regressions, and keep the holdout untouched until final comparison.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Use every case for iterative tuning until the whole dataset passes.

binary_cases.prompt: Turn an LLM judge into a release gate.
binary_cases.pass_rule: The evaluator is tested blind on labeled known-good, known-bad, and boundary cases, with false passes and false failures examined.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Calibrate the judge blind against labeled known-good, known-bad, and boundary cases; inspect false passes and false failures before gating releases.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Trust the judge without calibration because its rubric sounds precise.

binary_cases.prompt: Make a model comparison reproducible despite stochastic outputs.
binary_cases.pass_rule: The run records all material versions and settings, repeats unstable cases, and reports uncertainty rather than selecting a favorable run.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Record model, prompt, dataset, evaluator, commit, and inference settings. Repeat unstable cases and report variance or uncertainty.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Run each candidate once and keep the best run.

binary_cases.prompt: Decide whether to ship a candidate with a higher average score but a safety regression.
binary_cases.pass_rule: A critical regression blocks release even when the aggregate improves, and the decision inspects slices and individual examples.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Block the release: the improved aggregate cannot override a critical safety regression. Inspect the affected slice and per-example evidence.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Ship because the average score increased enough to offset the safety failures.

binary_cases.prompt: An AI behavior defect reached production. Define completion.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Completion includes a reproducible case, regression entry, detecting evaluator, system fix, and recurrence signal.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Minimize the failure, add it to the regression dataset, add an evaluator that catches it, fix the system, and monitor for recurrence.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Apply a fix only and close the incident.
